sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The RB-PSP2 key (RB-PSP2) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to one of the iron mesh doors in the Federal State Reserve Agency base underground supply warehouse.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - 3 of these, or 3 of the other RB-PSP and RB-PSV keys need to be found in raid for the quest Safe Corridor

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: This key opens the south-west caged off storage area in the Underground Storage Bunkers on Reserve (Highlighted in green).

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- One Medical Supply Crate
- Two Ration Supply Crates
- Two Technical Supply Crates

sections.heading: Trading
sections.text: | Cyclon rechargeable battery x7; Cyclon rechargeable battery; +; Flat screwdriver (Long) x5; Flat screwdriver (Long) | → | Jaeger; Jaeger LL4 | → | RB-PSP2 key; RB-PSP2 key |
